3.16 field-test email: by submitting this report, you authorize ColumbiaWalks to send the uploaded report only to a ColumbiaWalks-controlled test mailbox. The subject begins “[TEST]”; this field-test build does not send email to the Police Chief, Mayor, Codes, or any other government recipient. A picture and confirmed location within 5 km of Columbia Borough center are required; the test email includes the picture, location, comments, and any license-plate information. This is not emergency reporting and does not guarantee delivery, a response, or enforcement.

ColumbiaWalks reads only walking exercise sessions and their aggregate distance when you press Import. The app sends distance, duration, time range, source, and app version after you explicitly agree. It does not upload routes, health records unrelated to walking, or device identifiers. You can revoke access in Health Connect at any time.

Help improve ColumbiaWalks. Feedback is anonymous by default, and no separate subject is needed.

I consent to being contacted about this feedback.

Contact information stays hidden unless you opt in. Providing it does not grant permission to contact you unless you also select the consent box. Reports go first to ColumbiaWalks. Only a qualifying Crosswalk Encroachment or Missing Sidewalk report can authorize a [TEST] email to the ColumbiaWalks-controlled test mailbox. This 3.16 field-test build does not send those emails to the Police Chief, Mayor, Codes, or any other government recipient; all other reports and feedback remain within ColumbiaWalks unless disclosure is required by law or needed to protect people, rights, or the service.

Choose the destination that matches what you want to do. Each option explains where the information goes before you continue.
Prepare text locally for a past, non-active anonymous tip, then finish it on the Police Department’s official website. ColumbiaWalks does not receive the tip or media.
Comment on a public trash can, or send ColumbiaWalks a separate private can complaint.
Send an anonymous app comment, feature request, or bug report to ColumbiaWalks.

This tool only prepares text on your phone. It does not send a tip, upload a license-plate image, video, audio, document, or other media, or transmit anything to ColumbiaWalks. You will open and complete the Police Department’s official form yourself.
Call 911 now. Do not use an online form when someone is in danger, urgent help is needed, or an incident is happening now.
I confirm this is a past or non-active matter and no immediate response is needed.
Subject, observed date/time, location, and your firsthand observation are required. Enter only what you personally observed; do not guess.
Use plain text, for example: September 18, 2026 around 3:15 PM.
Describe only your firsthand observation. Include actions and identifying details without stating guesses as facts.
List the original photos, plate shots, video, audio, or documents you can attach later. Media stays on your device and is not uploaded by ColumbiaWalks.
NOT SUBMITTED YET — copying or opening the website does not send a tip.

On the official Police Department page: (1) choose Anonymous, (2) choose Other, (3) paste the prepared subject and narrative, (4) attach original evidence if appropriate — JPG, JPEG, PNG, TXT, PDF, AVI, MOV, MP4, MP3, or WAV, (5) personally read and make the required attestation, (6) complete reCAPTCHA, and (7) press the website’s Submit button. Review the text and attachments yourself before submitting.

What would you like to send?

PUBLIC COMMENT: This submission is sent to ColumbiaWalks for moderation and may be published. It is always marked as a public trash-can asset. Do not include private or sensitive personal information.

PRIVATE COMPLAINT: This submission is sent privately to ColumbiaWalks and is not published. ColumbiaWalks does not automatically forward it to Columbia Borough or any government agency. This is not an emergency or service-request guarantee.
